source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    if horizontal:
        axis, marker = 0, horizontal[0]
        line_color = grid[marker][0]
    elif vertical:
        axis, marker = 1, vertical[0]
        line_color = grid[0][marker]
    else:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    if axis == 0:
        points = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != line_color]
        if not points: return [row[:] for row in grid]
        top, bottom = min(r for r,c in points), max(r for r,c in points)
        shift = marker + 1 - top if top > marker else marker - 1 - bottom
        moved = [(r+shift,c,grid[r][c]) for r,c in points]
        out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
        out[marker] = [line_color]*w
        for r,c,v in moved:
            if 0 <= r < h: out[r][c]=v
        edge = (max(r for r,c,v in moved)+1 if top > marker else min(r for r,c,v in moved)-1)
        if 0 <= edge < h: out[edge]=[8]*w
    else:
        points = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != line_color]
        if not points: return [row[:] for row in grid]
        left, right = min(c for r,c in points), max(c for r,c in points)
        shift = marker + 1 - left if left > marker else marker - 1 - right
        moved = [(r,c+shift,grid[r][c]) for r,c in points]
        out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h): out[r][marker]=line_color
        for r,c,v in moved:
            if 0 <= c < w: out[r][c]=v
        edge = (max(c for r,c,v in moved)+1 if left > marker else min(c for r,c,v in moved)-1)
        if 0 <= edge < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][edge]=8
    return out
'''
